items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: This is my husband, Mr. Lissett.

ctx.x: Mr. Lissett. What are you doing in there, Mr. Adams? Mr. Adams. I was talking about the old, look at that beautiful little rabbit. Looks pretty tame. We're just about two. I'm not interrupting. No, no, no. We're just about two here, I guess, unless there's something else you can add.
Well, is anything interesting that you would like for me to add?
